section6.text1: We met in Burgundy, fell in love over long dinners and even longer walks through the vines. Now we are returning to the place where it all began, to begin the rest of our lives together.

section7.text2: Guests to arrive at the Orangery
section7.text11: Our ceremony will take place in the Orangery of Château de Belvent. This will be followed by an apéritif in the rose garden, before dinner and dancing in the old wine cellar.

section8.text8: We will be recovering on the garden terrace of Le Comptoir des Halles in Beaune from 12pm on Sunday, 13 June 2027. All are welcome to join us for a relaxed afternoon of food, wine and reminiscing about the night before. We would love to see you there! Children are welcome to join.

section2.text1: Some of the best love stories begin unexpectedly, and ours was no different.
section2.text2: What started as a chance encounter soon became endless conversations, spontaneous adventures, and countless memories together.
section2.text3: Somewhere along the way, we found our favorite place: by each other’s side.
section2.text4: And now, we're ready for our greatest adventure yet — a lifetime together.
